extracted.name: Tasteful Tahini Salad Dressing
extracted.description: This tasteful tahini salad dressing is full of flavor and easy to make with your favorite creamy tahini paste, tamari, vinegar, lemon, garlic, and ginger.
instruction_lines: Combine tahini, olive oil, water, tamari, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, ginger, garlic, and black pepper in a blender; blend until smooth.
